subject: That Space... with the playground in it.
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
Yeah, I know what you mean by 'space' as in Crackdown was a very vertical, jumpy over the buildingy game.  Lots of ground to run around and drive over but than at a moments notice, you could be 40 stories up, and that was very cool.  I can't off the top of my head think of many other games that have that kind of open playable area, like sandbox style that also had that instant up, up, and away along with it that Crackdown did.  I hope we see more of that in the future.   

CAPS LOCK - Cruise control for AWESOME!!
